name: 1923 Filet Mignon (Request No Peppercorn Crust)
whyItWorks: Center-cut beef filet mignon is the most tender, low-residue steak on the ship once you ask the kitchen to hold the cracked peppercorn crust.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask your server for the Filet Mignon cooked medium-rare to medium WITHOUT the cracked black/pink peppercorn crust and without the café au lait (coffee) butter. Pair with peeled mashed potatoes or the soft Yukon potato fondant from the chicken dish.
watchOuts: Fingerling potato skins and whole green beans
